player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id} ee game de Indian Poker.
- Dek ee 52-card; yin ee kek card de opponent.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) ee kɔ̈ɔ̈c, {max_rounds} kɔ̈ɔ̈c ee jɔ̈l.
- Luɔ̈ɔ̈i ee kuɛ̈ɛ̈t: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ee akɔ̈ɔ̈m kuɛ̈ɛ̈t ee chip yïn ee kuɛ̈ɛ̈t.)
- Card ee kuɛ̈ɛ̈t ee yɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ ee kuɛ̈ɛ̈t ee pot ee showdown.

invalid_move.cannot_check: Can't [check] - yïn acï rɔ̈m kekë wɛl ë kɔc.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Acïn kë bï yïn cɔɔl; alëu ba [check] looi.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Luɔ̈i [bet X] ba liep; acïn kë bï juak.
invalid_move.insufficient: Acie kä juëc ye kek looi.

message.showdown_win: Käk cï kek thɔ̈ɔ̈r: {card_win} aye gɔl në kë de {card_lose}.
message.showdown_tie: Kuɔny aye ciɛl: kek ɛɛ {card}. Kɔ̈k aye nyuɔ̈k – kek aye ciɛl {split}.

outcome.draw: Kä thöŋ në thää cï döŋ cök ëbën.
